info.title: Studio
info.description: Operations of Studio: reading, selecting and editing the widgets of the open project.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.summary: Returns the version of this contract.

methods.name: getSourceTree
methods.summary: Returns the widgets that the source of a file creates.
methods.description: The result has the widgets that no other widget contains, in source order, each with the widgets created inside its arguments. Branches that are not rendered are included.

params.name: uri
params.description: The file URI of a Dart file of the project.

methods.name: getRuntimeTree
methods.summary: Returns the widgets of the project in the running app, each with its creation location.
methods.description: The tree comes from the frame on the canvas. Widgets created outside the project are left out, and their descendants created in the project take their place.

methods.name: getSelection
methods.summary: Returns the selected widget, or null when nothing is selected.

methods.name: select
methods.summary: Selects a widget in every view and returns the widget that ended up selected.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.summary: Lists the parameters of the constructor that creates a widget.

params.name: target
params.description: The widget whose constructor is read.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.summary: Changes one argument of the constructor that creates a widget.
methods.description: The files are on disk when the call completes. The reload of the running app is requested but not awaited.

params.name: value
params.description: The new expression of the argument, or null to remove the argument.

methods.name: getStructureOptions
methods.summary: Tells which structural edits a widget accepts.

params.name: target
params.description: The widget that would be edited.

methods.name: wrapWidget
methods.summary: Wraps a widget with a new widget, which takes it as child.
methods.description: The wrapper has to be one of the wrappers that getStructureOptions lists for the widget.

params.name: wrapper
params.description: The widget to create around the target.

methods.name: removeWidget
methods.summary: Removes a widget from the code.
methods.description: With keepChildren set to true the children of the widget take its place. Removing the children as well is not supported in this version.

params.name: keepChildren
params.description: Whether the children of the widget stay in the code.

methods.name: reorderWidget
methods.summary: Moves a widget one place among its siblings.

params.name: direction
params.description: Where the widget goes in the list of its siblings.

methods.name: swapWidget
methods.summary: Swaps a widget with its parent or with its child.

params.name: partner
params.description: The widget that changes places with the target.

methods.name: extractWidget
methods.summary: Extracts a widget and its subtree to a new widget class in the same file.
methods.description: What the subtree uses from its surroundings becomes a parameter of the new class.

params.name: target
params.description: The widget at the top of the subtree to extract.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the new class, in UpperCamelCase.

methods.name: convertToStatefulWidget
methods.summary: Converts a StatelessWidget of the project into a StatefulWidget with its State class.

params.name: declaration
params.description: A position inside the name of the class, in its declaration, with the version of the document.

methods.name: undo
methods.summary: Undoes the last edit and restores the exact previous bytes of its files.
methods.description: When there is nothing to undo, the result has applied set to false and no change.

methods.name: redo
methods.summary: Applies again the edit that the last undo removed.
methods.description: When there is nothing to redo, the result has applied set to false and no change.

x-events.name: selectionChanged
x-events.description: The selection changed, from any view or client.

x-events.name: documentChanged
x-events.description: A document of the project changed and the change is on disk.

extensions.name: hello
extensions.description: Returns the version of the protocol of the design agent.

extensions.name: scene
extensions.description: Returns the scene mirror of the frame on screen: the geometry and the creation location of each element created in the project.

VersionInfo.description: The version of the contract of the Studio service.

Position.description: A position in a document, as the Language Server Protocol counts it.

line.description: Line of the position, starting at zero.

character.description: Offset in UTF-16 code units from the start of the line, starting at zero.

Range.description: The text between two positions of a document.

end.description: Position after the last one of the range.

WidgetRef.description: The creation location of a widget, in one version of the document.

uri.description: The file URI of the document that creates the widget.

position.description: Position of the constructor call that creates the widget.

documentVersion.description: Version of the document in which the position is valid.

Expression.description: A Dart expression, as source text.

source.description: The source text of the expression.

Property.description: One parameter of the constructor that creates a widget.

type.description: Kind of value, as the analysis server names it: string, int, double, bool, enum, or another name for a value that is not editable as a literal.

expression.description: The argument in the code, absent when no argument is given.

defaultValue.description: The default value of the parameter, absent when it has none.

isSet.description: Whether the code gives an argument for the parameter.

options.description: The values that an enum parameter accepts, absent for the other kinds.

documentation.description: Documentation of the parameter, absent when it has none.

TextEdit.description: Replacement of the text of a range.

range.description: The replaced text, in the document before the edit.

newText.description: The text that takes the place of the range.

TextDocumentEdit.description: The edits made to one document.

uri.description: The file URI of the document.

edits.description: The edits, with ranges that refer to the document before any of them.

ReloadKind.description: How the running app was asked to pick up an edit.

EditResult.description: The result of an edit operation.

changes.description: The edits made, one entry for each changed document.

documentVersions.description: Version of each changed document after the edit, by file URI.

reload.description: The reload that was requested from the running app.

selection.description: The selected widget, absent when nothing is selected.

uri.description: The file URI of the document.

documentVersion.description: Version of the document after the change.

WidgetSpec.description: A widget to create, named by its class.

libraryUri.description: The URI of the library that exports the class.

StructureOptions.description: The structural edits that a widget accepts.

wrappers.description: The widgets that wrapWidget accepts as wrapper.

canRemove.description: Whether removeWidget accepts the widget, keeping its children.

canMoveUp.description: Whether reorderWidget can move the widget up.

canMoveDown.description: Whether reorderWidget can move the widget down.

canSwapWithParent.description: Whether swapWidget can swap the widget with its parent.

canSwapWithChild.description: Whether swapWidget can swap the widget with its child.

MoveDirection.description: A direction in the list of the siblings of a widget.

SwapPartner.description: A neighbor of a widget in the tree.

SourceNode.description: A widget in the tree derived from the source of a file.

ref.description: The creation location of the widget.

owner.description: Qualified name of the declaration that creates the widget, present only in a widget that no other widget contains.

children.description: The widgets created inside the arguments of this one, in source order.

AgentInfo.description: What the design agent tells about itself.

protocolVersion.description: Version of the protocol between the shell and the agent.

isWidgetCreationTracked.description: Whether the app was built with the tracking of widget creation, without which no widget can be linked to its source.

SceneElement.description: One element created in the project, in the frame on screen.

className.description: Class of the widget of the element.

uri.description: The file URI of the document that creates the widget of the element.

position.description: Position of the constructor call that creates the widget.

parentIndex.description: Index, in the list of the scene, of the nearest ancestor created in the project, or -1.

left.description: Left edge of the bounds of the element on the surface, in logical pixels.

top.description: Top edge of the bounds of the element on the surface, in logical pixels.

width.description: Width of the bounds, in logical pixels.

height.description: Height of the bounds, in logical pixels.

layout.description: The constraints and the flex data of the widget, absent when its render object is not a box.

Scene.description: The scene mirror of one frame, in the JSON form of the first version of the agent.

width.description: Width of the surface, in logical pixels.

height.description: Height of the surface, in logical pixels.

devicePixelRatio.description: Physical pixels of a frame for each logical pixel.

elements.description: The elements created in the project, in the pre-order of the tree.

Bounds.description: A rectangle on the surface of the app, in logical pixels.

RuntimeNode.description: A widget of the project in the tree of the running app.

ref.description: The creation location of the widget, in the current version of its document.

bounds.description: Where the widget is on the surface.

children.description: The nearest descendants created in the project, in tree order.

layout.description: The constraints and the flex data of the widget, absent when its render object is not a box.

FlexFitKind.description: How a child of a flex layout fills the space given to it.

LayoutInfo.description: The layout data of a widget in the running app.

minWidth.description: Smallest width that the parent allows, in logical pixels.

maxWidth.description: Largest width that the parent allows, absent when the width is unbounded.

minHeight.description: Smallest height that the parent allows, in logical pixels.

maxHeight.description: Largest height that the parent allows, absent when the height is unbounded.

flex.description: The flex factor of the widget, present when its parent is a flex layout and gives it one.

fit.description: The flex fit of the widget, present when its parent is a flex layout.

StaleDocument.data: The current version of the document.

NotInProject.data: The URI that is outside the roots of the project.

EditRejected.data: The diagnostics that the edit would add.

NoSession.data: The session identifier that was not found.

UnsupportedTarget.data: The reason why the target does not accept the operation.

ToolchainUnavailable.data: The name of the process that is not running.
